DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードをなくされたのですね。いま分かる状況をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've lost your card, then. Please tell me what you know now.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝財布を開けて、カードがないと気付きました。最後に使った時刻が分からないので、まだ停止を頼めないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カード不在に気付き最終利用時刻が不明で停止相談を待ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I opened my wallet this morning and noticed the card was missing. I didn't know the last-use time, so thought I couldn't request a stop yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you noticed the missing card but delayed asking about stopping it because the last-use time was unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分かる範囲で伺います。気付いた時刻と、最後の利用を思い出せる範囲は別に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll ask what you know. Tell us separately when you noticed and what you can remember of the last use.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ないと気付いたのは七時です。使ったのは昨日の夕方ですが、何時かは覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発覚七時と前日夕方の利用を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: I noticed it was missing at seven. I used it yesterday evening but don't remember what time.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the seven-o'clock discovery separately from the previous evening's use in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず停止について担当へおつなぎします。利用の記録も確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: First I'll connect you to the person responsible for stopping it. The usage records need checking too.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家へレシートを取りに戻るより、今ここで停止の相談を先に進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料を取りに戻る前に停止相談を優先したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than go home for receipts, I'd like to prioritize discussing the stop here now.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to prioritize the stop consultation before going back for documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人確認の資料はお持ちですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。昨日の支払いを全部カードでしたか、現金も使ったかは混ざっているので、断定せず記録を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人資料を示し現金とカードの利用記憶を断定しないと補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here. My memory of whether all yesterday's payments were by card or some were cash is mixed, so I'd like to check records without making definite claims.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your identification and add in Japanese that you will not claim certainty about remembered cash and card usage.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できていない点も分けて担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll distinguish the unconfirmed points too when telling staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。停止の結果を聞き、利用履歴で不明な取引があれば、その日付と金額で追加の相談をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止結果と利用履歴を確認し不明取引を具体的に追加相談すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I'll hear the stop result and, if there are unfamiliar transactions in the history, ask further using their specific dates and amounts.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the stop result and transaction history and ask specifically about unknown transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。気付いた時刻と利用時刻の不明点を伝え、停止の担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll explain the discovery time and uncertainty about use times, then direct you to the card-stop staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り換えの案内をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for transfer information?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「南改札」で調べても駅が出ません。友人からここで乗り換えると言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 改札名を駅名として検索したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Searching “South Ticket Gates” doesn't bring up a station. My friend told me to transfer here.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you searched a gate name as though it were a station name.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 南改札は構内の位置を表す名前です。乗り換える路線は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: South Ticket Gates is a name for a location within the station. Do you know the line you're transferring to?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青い線とだけ聞きました。同じ色の案内を見ればよいと思って、路線名を聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 色しか聞いておらず路線名が未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only heard “the blue line.” I thought I just needed signs of the same color and didn't ask the line name.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you only heard a color and have not confirmed the line name.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 色だけではなく路線名と行き先を確認しましょう。友人のメッセージをもう一度見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the line name and destination, not just the color. Can you look at your friend's message again?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見ます。続きに路線名がありました。この名前の線へ乗り換えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: メッセージ全文から正式路線名を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll look. The line name was further down the message. I'd like to transfer to the line with this name.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the official line name from the complete message in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できました。今いる改札からその線へ進む経路をご案内します。改札を出る必要があるかも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Confirmed. I'll show the route from your current gates to that line. Let's also check whether you need to leave the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。南改札と書いてあるから、必ず外へ出るとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 改札名だけで構外へ出ると判断せず経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I won't assume I must go outside just because it says South Ticket Gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the route without assuming a gate name means leaving the station.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この学習場面では、構内の連絡通路を使います。表示の路線名を途中でもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: In this learning scenario, you use the connecting passage inside the station. Check the displayed line name along the way too.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。駅名ではなく路線名で探し、外へ出ず連絡通路へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 路線名を照合して構内連絡通路を使うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll search by line name rather than station name and take the connecting passage without going outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will match the line name and use the internal connecting passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの通路です。次の案内板でも路線名を照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: This is the passage. Match the line name at the next information board too.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散策の経路についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the walking route?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 反対側から出るつもりです。ただ、入口の近くへ荷物を預けたので、帰りに取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通り抜け予定と入口側の預け荷物を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to leave on the opposite side. However, I stored luggage near the entrance and want to collect it on the way home.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese your plan to pass through and the stored luggage on the entrance side.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物の受取場所は、こちらの入口側なのですね。反対側から出た後もそこへ戻る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So collection is by this entrance. Do you plan to return there after leaving the opposite exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外を回ればすぐだと思っていました。園内を戻る方と、どちらが時間を見込みやすいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外回りと園内帰路の所要を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought going around outside would be quick. Which is easier to allow time for, that or returning through the garden?
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the time needed for an outside circuit versus returning within the garden.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここでは、受け取りの場所へ戻る園内の経路をご案内します。荷物の受取期限は確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here, we'll show the route inside the garden back to collection. Have you checked the luggage collection deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 控えには四時半までとあります。散策を四時半まで続けるのでなく、受け取りに間に合うよう戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取期限を散策終了時刻と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The receipt says by four thirty. I won't keep walking until four thirty; I'll return in time to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese the collection deadline from the time to finish walking.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 終点から戻る時間も含めてください。反対側の出口を目的にした長いコースは選ばない方針ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Include the return time from the endpoint too. Do you intend to avoid the long route toward the opposite exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今日は短い周回に変えます。同行者には通り抜けではないと知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短い周回へ変更し同行者へ知らせると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll change to a short loop today. I'll tell my companion we're not passing all the way through.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to change to a short loop and notify your companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの周回図です。途中で長い方へ進む場合は、残り時間を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the loop map. If you take the longer direction partway through, check the time remaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。荷物の場所へ戻る時刻を先に決め、短い周回を歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物回収への帰着時刻を基準に散策する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll decide my return time to the luggage place first, then walk the short loop.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will plan the walk around the time to return for luggage collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その経路でお楽しみください。受取条件は荷物の控えもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy that route. Check the luggage receipt for collection conditions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お待ち合わせでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble meeting someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の写真に像が写っています。でも同じ角度の場所へ立つと、通路をふさいでしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の角度を合わせると通路を塞ぐと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a statue in my friend's photo. But standing at the same angle would block the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that matching the photograph's angle would obstruct the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その写真は、待つ位置を指定したものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the photograph specify where you should wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこまでは書いてありません。像が同じ大きさに見える位置へ行けば会えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真は待機位置の指定か未確認だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It doesn't say that much. I thought I'd find my friend if I stood where the statue looked the same size.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not confirmed whether the photo specifies a waiting spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真の撮影位置と安全に待てる場所は別です。友人へ場所を指定して連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The photo-taking position and a safe place to wait are different. Can you tell your friend a specific location?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: できます。像の前そのものではなく、横の広い場所へ移ったと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 安全な横の場所へ移動したと連絡したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to tell them I moved to the wide area beside it, not directly in front of the statue.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to notify your friend you moved to a safe place at the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通行の邪魔にならない位置でお願いします。どの目印を相手へ伝えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please choose a position that doesn't obstruct passage. What landmark will you tell them?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この案内板です。写真の角度を再現するのではなく、案内板の文字も送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真再現でなく案内板の文字を目印として送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: This information board. Instead of recreating the photo angle, I'll send the board's wording too.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will send the information-board wording as a landmark rather than recreate the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 位置を変えたことが伝わるまで、さらに別の場所へ移らないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Until they understand you changed position, try not to move to another place again.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人が写真だけを探さないよう、移動した場所と目印を送ってここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 位置変更を共有して新たな移動を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll send where I moved and the landmark so my friend doesn't search only from the photo, then wait here.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will share the location change and avoid moving again.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その位置で通路を空けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the passage clear and wait at that position.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは催しの整理券についての案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is information about numbered tickets for an event.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: これを持てば展望の入場も予約済みだと思いました。入場の日時が見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 催し整理券を展望入場予約と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought having this meant observation-area admission was reserved too. I can't find an admission date or time.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook an event numbered ticket for an observation-admission reservation.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 催しへの参加と施設の入場は別です。入場券を購入された記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Event participation and facility admission are separate. Do you have a record of buying admission tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありません。整理券の申込み画面を保存しただけです。それも参加が確定した表示かは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入場購入はなく整理券申込結果も未確認だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I only saved the event-ticket application screen. I haven't checked whether even that displays confirmed participation.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not bought admission and have not checked the event-ticket application result either.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの状態を分けて確認しましょう。催しだけが目的ですか、展望もご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check those two statuses separately. Is the event your only purpose, or would you like the observation area too?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 展望が目的で、催しは時間が合えばです。催しを優先して入場時間を無理に決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 展望を主目的として優先順位を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The observation area is my purpose, and the event only if the timing works. I don't want to force an admission time around prioritizing the event.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State in Japanese that the observation area is your main purpose and explain your priorities.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入場できる時間と条件を先に確認できます。催しの参加結果は、主催者の案内を照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check available admission times and conditions first. For the event result, compare the organizer's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。施設の入場と催しを同じ予約として扱わず、参加結果も別に見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 施設入場と催し参加の受付状態を別々に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't treat facility admission and the event as one reservation, and I'll check the participation result separately too.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check facility admission and event participation statuses separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日の利用を決める前に、それぞれの受付状態をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before deciding today's visit, please confirm each registration status.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。入場時間を先に相談し、催しは確定した時刻が合う場合に検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入場時間を先に決め催しは合う場合のみ検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll discuss admission time first and consider the event only if its confirmed time fits.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will decide admission time first and consider the event only if it fits.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 入場の窓口はこちらです。催しの問い合わせ先もお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: The admission counter is here. I'll also give you the event inquiry contact.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 現在の住所が分かる書類をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a document showing your current address?

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そう思って来ましたが、会社の案内に「入社時の住所」とあります。今の住所だけでは違うかもしれません。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出先が求める過去時点と現在住所の違いを指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-02.translation: That's what I thought when coming, but the company's instructions say “address when joining the company.” My current address alone might not be right.
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out in Japanese the difference between the past date requested by the recipient and your current address.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 証明したい時点も重要ですね。入社後に住所は変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-03.translation: The time you need to certify matters too. Has your address changed since you joined?

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、一度引っ越しました。今の住所を入社時の住所として書いたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入社後に転居し住所を混同していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I moved once. I haven't written my current address as my address when I joined.
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you moved after joining and have not confused the addresses.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出先がどの時点と内容を求めているか、先に確認してください。手元に案内がありますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-05.translation: First check which date and information the recipient requires. Do you have the instructions with you?

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。書類名はなく、入社時点の記録とだけあります。今は発行を依頼せず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類名は未指定で発行前の相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here. They don't name a document, only say a record as of joining. For now I'd like advice without requesting issuance.
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that no document name is specified and you want advice before issuance.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 求められる内容が分かれば、対応する窓口へ確認できます。以前の住所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once the required details are clear, we can ask the relevant counter. Do you know your previous address?

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の記録にあります。ただ、そのメモ自体が公的な証明になるとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧住所の私的記録と公的証明を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's in my own records. But I don't think that note itself is official certification.
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese your private record of the old address from official certification.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その区分でご相談ください。取得できる書類の範囲は担当が説明します。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult on that basis. The adviser will explain which documents can be obtained.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。会社へ証明したい日付と必要項目を聞き、現在の住所用の書類を先に選ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 証明対象の日付項目を確認してから書類を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll ask the company the date and required fields to certify, rather than choose a current-address document first.
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose a document after confirming the certification date and fields.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本日は要件確認の相談として担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-001-SHARED-11.translation: Today I'll direct you to staff for a consultation about checking the requirements.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知のどの部分についてですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the notice are you asking about?

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四月と書いてありますが、届いたのは六月です。二か月遅れて発送されたという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-02.hintJa: 対象月を発送月と思った疑問を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-02.translation: It says April, but arrived in June. Does that mean it was mailed two months late?
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about having mistaken the covered month for the mailing month.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 四月は対象期間の欄です。発送日とは別に記載されています。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-03.translation: April is in the covered-period field. It is written separately from the mailing date.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、届いた日が六月でも、六月の分についての通知ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象期間と到着日を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-04.translation: Then even though it arrived in June, it isn't a notice about June's situation.
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the covered period from the arrival date in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象の期間について確認する担当へご案内します。何を相談したいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-05.translation: I'll direct you to the staff who check that period. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四月にはまだ今の仕事を始めていません。六月の収入をそのまま四月の状況として答えそうでした。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在収入を過去期間へ当てはめかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-06.translation: In April, I hadn't started my current job yet. I nearly answered using June's income as if it were my April situation.
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you nearly applied current income to a past period.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 時点を分けて資料を準備してください。通知の回答期限も確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-07.translation: Prepare documents distinguishing the time periods. Have you checked the response deadline too?

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 期限は来週です。四月と書いてあるから、もう期限を過ぎたと思って放置していました。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象月と回答期限を混同していたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-08.translation: It's next week. Because it said April, I thought the deadline had already passed and left it unattended.
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you confused the covered month with the response deadline.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象期間と回答期限を別にご確認ください。受付条件は担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-09.translation: Check the covered period separately from the response deadline. You can discuss acceptance conditions with staff.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。四月の状況が分かる資料と通知を持ち、来週の期限までの対応を相談します。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当該期間の資料で期限内対応を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll bring the notice and documents showing April's situation and ask what to do before next week's deadline.
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will discuss responding within the deadline using documents for the relevant period.

DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当窓口はこちらです。通知は全体をそのままお見せください。
DLG-SC-TKY-GOV-002-SHARED-11.translation: The responsible counter is here. Please show the entire notice as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初診の用紙はこちらの方のものですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This first-visit form belongs to this person, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父の受診です。私が書くので自分の名前を入れましたが、患者の欄だったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記入者自身の名前を書いたが患者は父だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The patient is my father. Since I'm filling it in, I wrote my own name, but that was the patient field.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct in Japanese that you wrote the form-filler's name but the patient is your father.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 患者のお名前と、記入を手伝う方は分けます。お父様はご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We distinguish the patient's name from the person helping fill it in. Is your father here with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、隣にいます。内容は父に確かめてから書きたいです。私の病歴ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父が同席し本人の情報を確認して書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, beside me. I'd like to check the information with him before writing. It isn't my medical history.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your father is present and you will confirm his own information before writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい用紙で、患者ご本人について記入しましょう。今の用紙には何を書かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's use a new form for the patient's details. What did you write on the current one?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前と生年月日だけで、どちらも私のものです。父の情報へ数字だけ直さず、用紙を替えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の氏名生年月日だけを記した旧紙を交換する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only a name and date of birth, both mine. I'll replace the form rather than just change the numbers to my father's information.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will replace the old form containing only your own name and birth date.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人の情報を確認して進めてください。連絡先はどなたの番号を使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the patient's information as you proceed. Whose phone number do you plan to use for contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父の番号です。私を連絡先にする必要がある場合は、別の欄で関係も説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 父の連絡先と補助者の連絡先を別欄で区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My father's. If I need to be the contact, I'll use a separate field and explain the relationship too.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish your father's contact details from the helper's in separate fields in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。記入者が患者本人とは限らないことも担当に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Confirmed. I'll tell staff too that the form-filler isn't necessarily the patient.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。父に確認した内容を新しい紙へ書き、私が手伝ったと示して提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 患者と記入補助者を明示して提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I'll put the information confirmed with my father on the new sheet and submit it showing that I helped.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will submit with the patient and writing helper clearly identified.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その用紙で受付を確認します。書きかけの紙も誤記としてお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check reception with that form. Please also hand over the partially completed sheet as an incorrect form.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような書類をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of document would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ相談したことを伝える紙です。被害を認めた証明を出してもらえばよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談記録を被害認定書として欲しいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: A paper telling my company I sought advice. I thought I should get a certificate recognizing that I was a victim.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you wanted a consultation record as though it were a certificate recognizing harm.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談した事実と、出来事についての判断は別です。会社は何を求めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The fact that you consulted and a judgment about the events are separate. What does your company require?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談日時が分かる物と言っています。被害認定の書類を指定したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先の指定は日時が分かる物だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: They say something showing the consultation date and time. They haven't specified a document recognizing victim status.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your workplace specified something showing the date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内できる記録について担当へ確認します。会社へ相談内容の全部を渡す予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with staff which records we can provide. Do you plan to give the company the entire consultation content?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ決めていません。日時だけ必要か、内容も必要かを会社へ聞いてから依頼したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要な開示項目を会社へ確認してから依頼したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't decided. I'd like to ask the company whether they need only the date and time or the contents too before making a request.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to confirm the required disclosure items with your company before requesting a document.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な項目が確認できたら、発行できる範囲と手続きを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once the required items are clear, we'll explain what can be issued and the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。相談したことを、捜査や認定が完了したこととして会社へ伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相談済みと判断完了を区別して伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't tell the company that having consulted means an investigation or determination has been completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to distinguish having consulted from a completed determination when reporting.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その区分でご説明ください。いまお持ちの相談番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain it on that basis. Do you have a consultation number with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: あります。番号と相談日で確認をお願いします。書類名は決めず、必要な内容を先に整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談番号と日を提示し内容から発行範囲を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please check using the number and consultation date. Rather than decide a document name, I'll organize the required content first.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present the consultation number and date in Japanese and discuss the scope of issuance based on needed contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ照会します。発行については確認結果をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll ask the staff. Please wait for the confirmation result about issuance.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの机のどこを確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of this desk would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二十キロと書いてあるので、一人で持って帰るには重すぎると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 耐荷重二十キロを本体重量と解釈したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says twenty kilograms, so I thought it was too heavy to take home alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you interpreted the twenty-kilogram load capacity as the desk's own weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二十キロは天板の耐荷重です。本体の重量とは別の表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Twenty kilograms is the tabletop's load capacity. It's a separate figure from the desk's weight.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 机自体の重さではないのですね。持ち運ぶために、本体重量を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 運搬に必要な本体重量を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it isn't how much the desk itself weighs. I'd like its actual weight to plan carrying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the desk's own weight needed for transportation.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品は本体が八キロの設定です。畳んで持つ方法も説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this product scenario, the desk itself weighs eight kilograms. We can also explain how to fold and carry it.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 八キロなら必ず一人で運べると決めず、持つ位置と畳んだ脚の固定を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重量だけで単独運搬を決めず持ち方と脚固定を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume eight kilograms means I can definitely carry it alone. I'd like to see where to hold it and how the folded legs lock.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not decide on carrying it alone from weight only and will check grip positions and leg fastening.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が見本で説明します。荷物を天板へ載せたまま運ぶものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will demonstrate with the sample. You don't carry it with belongings still on the tabletop.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。耐荷重以内の物なら載せたまま移動できるという意味でもないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 耐荷重内でも積載移動の許可ではないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. The load capacity also doesn't mean you may move it while anything below that weight remains on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge in Japanese that being within load capacity does not permit moving it while loaded.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。移動の方法と使用時の条件は別です。持ち帰り方はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's right. Moving methods and conditions during use are separate. How will you take it home?

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は荷物もあるので、配達の条件を聞いてから買うか決めます。耐荷重を運搬重量には使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 使用条件と運搬条件を分け配達確認後に購入判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have other luggage today, so I'll ask about delivery conditions before deciding to buy. I won't use load capacity as its carrying weight.
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate use conditions from transport conditions and decide on purchase after checking delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 配達の担当へご案内します。本体の重量と使用条件の資料もお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-013-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll direct you to delivery staff and give you information on the desk's weight and use conditions too.
